title: OOI 海洋觀測網
summary: 以OOI連網觀測架構為案例，將繫留站、海纜與感測器視為資料生產鏈；分析供電、時間同步、缺測與版本管理。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use OOI networked observations to view moorings, cables and sensors as a data-production chain, analyzing power, timing, missingness and version management. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 畫出繫留站的力與位移介面：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Draw force/displacement interfaces of a mooring: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 畫出繫留站的力與位移介面 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Draw force/displacement interfaces of a mooring and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 畫出繫留站的力與位移介面：在小位移線性化附近，水平偏移可由外力除等效剛度估計；大位移下繫泊幾何非線性重要。 本步以「繫泊等效剛度與偏移」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Draw force/displacement interfaces of a mooring: Near a small-displacement linearization, horizontal offset is force over equivalent stiffness; large offsets require nonlinear mooring geometry. Use Mooring equivalent stiffness and offset to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是OOI 海洋觀測網實際規格：水平環境力F=204 kN、等效剛度k=50 kN/m。式 x=F/k，基準結果 4.08 m。條件：一維靜力線性示意；不含錨、土壤、線斷裂或真實允許偏移。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Ocean Observatories Initiative network: Horizontal environmental force F=204 kN, equivalent stiffness k=50 kN/m. Formula x=F/k gives 4.08 m. Conditions: One-dimensional static linear illustration excluding anchors, soil, line breakage and real allowable offset.
steps.failure: 把小位移剛度外推到大偏移會低估或高估張力；檢查模型有效範圍。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Extrapolating small-offset stiffness can misestimate large-offset tensions; inspect validity range. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 畫出力-位移曲線在工作點的切線，將一根線失效情境與原剛度分開，不沿用舊k。 本案例另須檢查「畫出繫留站的力與位移介面」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Draw the tangent to a force-displacement curve at its operating point; treat one-line loss separately rather than reusing the original stiffness. Also check that Draw force/displacement interfaces of a mooring and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：畫出繫留站的力與位移介面。在海洋觀測網拓樸、合成資料封包、品質旗標與維修日誌完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加環境力10%，保持線性剛度，說明何時應停止使用線性模型。 算式區的基準值為4.08，改變後為4.488 m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Draw force/displacement interfaces of a mooring. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Observation-network topology, synthetic packets, quality flags and maintenance logs. Increase environmental force alone by 10%, retain linear stiffness and explain when to stop using the approximation. Baseline 4.08 changes to 4.488 m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

steps.instruction: 用空氣中線重會高估水中自重，卻仍可能漏掉海流拖曳；不可相互抵銷錯誤。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.instructionEn: Air weight overstates submerged weight but may still omit current drag; the errors must not be assumed to cancel. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是OOI 海洋觀測網實際規格：有效線重w=5.1 N/m、長L=200 m、端部力500 N。式 T=wL+Fend，基準結果 1520 N。條件：直垂靜線，不含懸鏈線、彎曲剛度、動態與強度；不作纜線選型。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Ocean Observatories Initiative network: Effective line weight w=5.1 N/m, L=200 m, end load 500 N. Formula T=wL+Fend gives 1520 N. Conditions: Straight vertical static line excluding catenary, bending, dynamics and strength; not cable selection.
steps.failure: 用空氣中線重會高估水中自重，卻仍可能漏掉海流拖曳；不可相互抵銷錯誤。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Air weight overstates submerged weight but may still omit current drag; the errors must not be assumed to cancel. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 沿纜線每隔一段累加有效重量，檢查頂端張力大於下端；分清空氣重與水中重。 本案例另須檢查「把感測器重量列入纜線帳」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Accumulate effective weight along sections and check top tension exceeds bottom tension; distinguish air and submerged weight. Also check that Include sensor weight in line accounting and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：把感測器重量列入纜線帳。在海洋觀測網拓樸、合成資料封包、品質旗標與維修日誌完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加有效線重10%，保持長度與端力，重算頂端張力。 算式區的基準值為1520，改變後為1622 N。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Include sensor weight in line accounting. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Observation-network topology, synthetic packets, quality flags and maintenance logs. Increase effective line weight alone by 10%, fix length and end load and recalculate top tension. Baseline 1520 changes to 1622 N. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Air weight overstates submerged weight but may still omit current drag; the errors must not be assumed to cancel.
